title: Design System: Willis Wee — Save Point Atlas

home-display.purpose: The Start statement with a 12ch measure. At 1100px its clamp becomes 3rem/6vw/4.5rem; at 760px it becomes 2.65rem/13vw/4rem.

home-headline.purpose: Work, Notes, Life, and Connect headings. At 1100px the clamp becomes 2.45rem/5.2vw/3.8rem; at 760px it becomes 2.3rem/10.8vw/3.55rem.

essay-title.purpose: Longer essay headings with a 22ch measure; 2.25rem at 1100px and 1.875rem/1.25 at 760px.

entry-title.purpose: Repeated book titles and gratitude note headings.

reading-body.purpose: Long-form articles and Guide/Work body text.

control.purpose: Navigation, filters, discovery controls, and dock labels.

metadata.purpose: Dates, reading estimates, counts, captions, and category labels; dates and counts use tabular numerals.

status.purpose: The approved compact status badge; prefix is omitted on narrow phones.

reading-section.purpose: Essay, More thoughts, and newsletter section headings. Guide inherits the size with a 1.4 line height and smaller mobile variants documented in DESIGN.md.

archive-year.purpose: Recurring year headings in the Thoughts index.

essay-subtitle.purpose: An introductory deck below an essay title, reduced to 1.1875rem on mobile.

quotation.purpose: Longer essay quotations; inherits the article line height.

work-headline.purpose: The five project headings on Work, reduced to 1.5rem on mobile.

brand.purpose: The existing wordmark. The homepage uses 0.74rem on mobile; navigation retains its separate 14px role.

home-row-title.purpose: Repeated work, archive, and contact destinations in the scene panels.

home-onward.purpose: The destination text in each Scroll next link.

continuation-title.purpose: Full titles in the More thoughts invitation; Sora at 600 with a 1.55 line height.

search-text.purpose: Archive search text and placeholder, with a 1.6 line height.

brand-compact.purpose: The short mobile Willis logotype at 0.74rem; the homepage alone reduces to 0.68rem at 360px.

shadows.name: header
shadows.purpose: Separates the fixed header from the scene.

shadows.name: story-panel
shadows.purpose: Separates a homepage reading plate from art.

shadows.name: reading-panel
shadows.purpose: Frames the continuous inner-page reading pane.

shadows.name: discovery-dock
shadows.purpose: Separates compact floating controls from the document.

shadows.name: footnote
shadows.purpose: Lifts an optional footnote preview above the reading surface.

motion.name: control-color
motion.purpose: Acknowledges shared hover and focus state; useful color and border feedback uses 120ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: search-border
motion.purpose: Turns the archive search border gold on focus; 120ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: destination-arrow
motion.purpose: Moves only the northeast vector on hover or keyboard focus, keeping the link target stationary; suppressed under reduced motion.

motion.name: onward-arrow
motion.purpose: Acknowledges the homepage onward link on hover or keyboard focus; suppressed under reduced motion.

motion.name: story-settle
motion.purpose: Settles already-visible homepage panels; suppressed under reduced motion.

motion.name: art-settle
motion.purpose: Subtly adjusts the current homepage scene; suppressed under reduced motion.

motion.name: reload-feedback
motion.purpose: Turns the status reload icon on activation; reduced motion keeps it stationary and uses opacity feedback.

motion.name: dice-feedback
motion.purpose: Turns the discovery dice on deliberate input; suppressed under reduced motion.

motion.name: landscape-fade
motion.purpose: Quiets surrounding entries, introduction, and scenery while a selected Book/Gratitude entry is visible; changes immediately under reduced motion.

components.css: .ds-search{font-family:var(--font-body,"Sora",sans-serif)}.ds-search label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--cream-soft,#ddd6c8);font-size:var(--font-size-ui,.875rem);font-weight:500}.ds-search-field{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:48px;padding-left:14px;border:1px solid var(--line,rgba(244,233,207,.24));background:var(--ink,#07101d);transition:border-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-search-field:focus-within{border-color:var(--gold,#ffbe63)}.ds-search-field:has(input:focus-visible){outline:3px solid var(--gold,#ffbe63);outline-offset:3px}.ds-search-field>svg{flex:0 0 18px;width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:var(--muted,#aeb5bd);stroke-width:1.5}.ds-search-field input{flex:1 1 auto;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:46px;padding:10px 12px 10px 0;border:0;border-radius:0;color:var(--cream,#f4e9cf);background:transparent;caret-color:var(--gold,#ffbe63);font:400 var(--font-size-ui,.875rem)/1.6 var(--font-body,"Sora",sans-serif)}.ds-search-field input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#aeb5bd);opacity:1}.ds-search-field input:focus-visible{outline:none}.ds-search-field input::-webkit-search-cancel-button{-webkit-appearance:none}.ds-search-field button{display:grid;flex:0 0 44px;place-items:center;width:44px;min-height:44px;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#aeb5bd);cursor:pointer}.ds-search-field button:is(:hover,:focus-visible){color:var(--gold,#ffbe63)}.ds-search-field button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold,#ffbe63);outline-offset:-4px}.ds-search-field button svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-search-field{transition-duration:120ms}}

narrative.overview:
The site pairs a personal pixel-art journey with a quiet reading room. The homepage has five scenes: Start, Work, Notes, Life, and Connect. Its illustrated Singapore landscapes carry the atmosphere; framed navy panels carry the words. A compact fixed header and active gold underline provide orientation without a journey rail or game-key interface.

The same world continues through Coaching, Guide, Work, Books, Gratitude, the Thoughts archive, and individual essays. The not-found page ("Off the map.") uses the shared forest-path scene, a "Willis" dialogue box, and three ways back. Their dedicated landscapes sit beside an opaque reading pane on desktop and form a short opening band on mobile. Silkscreen gives short declarations a distinctive voice; Sora carries prose, navigation, metadata, and controls. Content stays readable while discovery and navigation enhance the static document.

This is a refresh of the implemented world, not a replacement direction. The source of truth is `home-game.css`, `thoughts/reading-room.css`, and the route styles for Coaching, Guide, Work, Books, and Gratitude. Surface briefs hold route-specific composition and historical decisions; dated delivery restrictions in those histories do not define permission for future work.
keyCharacteristics: **Five-scene introduction:** Full-width pixel landscapes and alternating reading panels introduce identity, work, writing, life, and connection.
**Shared reading room:** Opaque ink panes protect long-form reading across every inner page.
**Two complementary fonts:** Silkscreen marks the world; Sora carries the reading and control interface.
**Restrained geometry:** Square frames, thin rules, opposing gold corners, and drawn arrows connect the surfaces.
**Progressive enhancement:** Native links and complete static content survive unavailable JavaScript; enhanced controls appear only when ready.

rules.name: The Ink-Plate Rule
rules.body: Reading text sits on an ink surface. Scenery, veils, and shadows provide atmosphere without determining text contrast.

rules.name: The Readable Selection Rule
rules.body: Focus mode dims neighboring entries, introductory text, and decorative scenery while the selected entry is in the reading viewport. Scrolling away restores normal contrast without discarding the selection or its link; returning restores focus. Keyboard-focused entries remain readable.

rules.name: The Translation Rule
rules.body: Silkscreen owns short declarations and the established brief chapter cues. Sora owns sentences and the navigational interface. Never set paragraph-length copy in the pixel face.

dos: Do preserve the five-scene pixel-art homepage and the shared dark reading room across inner pages.
Do use opaque ink surfaces for long-form text and restore normal contrast when readers scroll away from a focused entry.
Do keep Sora navigation and metadata readable and controls at least 44px across compact viewports.
Do use down arrows for onward scrolling, northeast arrows for destination links, and vectors rather than arrow emoji.
Do retain all authored content, stable anchors, image descriptions, and complete no-JavaScript reading paths.
Do verify long titles, all status strings, 320px layouts, enlarged text, keyboard focus, and reduced motion when changing shared components.
donts: Don't restore the removed journey rail, game keycaps, or Keep reading dock action from historical screenshots or briefs.
Don't leave the page dimmed when the selected entry is outside the reading viewport.
Don't truncate status copy or disable text enlargement to force the badge onto one line.
Don't replace the established pixel artwork, square frames, or two-font pairing during a refinement.
Don't expose an inactive control before its enhancement has initialized.
Don't treat dated scope or deployment statements in archived briefs as current permission.
